message.content: {"basis":"The pie chart 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' labels each slice with a percentage share: Nuclear (45%), Hydroelectric (30%), Fossil Fuels (15%), and Renewables (10%). Comparing these values, Nuclear is the largest category. The routing criterion requires escalating the largest category to priority source monitoring, and the corresponding option is available.","option_label":"Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring"}
